stemMd: Unit cubes form stacks of heights 2,0,1,3 on four cells of a square grid. How many unit squares are occupied in the top-view footprint?
explanationMd: A top footprint records whether each cell contains at least one cube, not stack height. Three heights are positive, so three unit squares appear.

distractorRationale.e: This counts cubes, not occupied grid cells.
distractorRationale.a: Each nonempty stack occupies its own grid cell.
distractorRationale.b: This counts only stacks higher than one.
